title: Open-Ended Peripheral-Roller Trommel Screen
description: One newly authored complete static mine-processing appearance: a single thick cylindrical screen with two fully open axial mouths and twenty real surrounding windows, carried on four peripheral rollers under its full end bands. There is no central drum-supporting spindle, end plate, closed bottom or lid. Eight bored roller-axle housings, two end frames, tied base rails and four flat feet form the whole fixed support assembly. A separate continuous thick open catch funnel with a short genuine outlet neck sits beneath the central screen span; it is not claimed to collect every window. This differs structurally from the old closed-end spindle-supported garden composter, closed-bottom pear-drum mixer and flat seven-bar grizzly, not merely a barrel with more holes or new colors. All main geometry newly authored with mature annular and cell-shell primitives. Static visual art only: no rotation, motor, actual screening/flow capacity, precision bearing, assembly/manufacturing, load or equipment safety claim.
